home.eyebrow: A little curiosity. A whole new way to listen.
home.title:
There’s a world
inside your sound.
home.intro: Discover what moves you, what draws you in, and where music could take you next.
home.note: 30 questions · No account needed to start
home.tag: YOUR NEXT DISCOVERY STARTS WITH YOU
home.cardTitle:
Not just what you listen to.
How you listen.
home.step1: Explore 30 short questions about the way you experience music. Your progress saves as you go.
home.step2: Create an account or sign in at the end to see your free musical profile.
home.step3: Choose a paid report for your five listening dimensions and a personal listening exercise.
home.transparency: Your profile is free after sign-in. The complete report is a separate, one-time purchase.
home.editorial: A playful exploration of listening preferences, not a psychological or intelligence assessment.
home.journalText: Stories, sheet music and guided lessons are on the horizon. For now, start with your sound.
home.footer: Music is a place to find yourself.
